Según La Jornada, la Haya., El máximo órgano judicial de la Organización de Naciones Unidas (ONU) dictaminó ayer que los miles de asesinatos y actos generalizados de violencia sexual perpetrados por las fuerzas de seguridad de Myanmar contra la minoría musulmana rohinyá en 2017 constituyen genocidio. stories.narrEn: According to France 24, the United Nations International Court of Justice on Thursday ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Muslim Rohingya minority. The Diplomat reports: Myanmar's security forces killed thousands of Rohingya civilians and committed "widespread sexual violence" against women and "extreme violence" against children, the court said. According to The Citizen (Sudáfrica), the judgment marks the first time the ICJ has found a state responsible for genocide. According to BBC, the unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.
